title: Grand Island Mitigation Site
description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Project Description: Grand Island Mitigation Project Anticipated Posting Date: 09 October 2026 Sources Sought Number: W9123827X1CQX SAM Posting Title: USACE SPK DBB Construction � Grand Island Mitigation Project � Sacramento, California SAM Posting Description: This Sources Sought Notice is being issued for market research purposes to determine the availability, capability, and interest of small business firms for a potential Government requirement. NO SOLICITATION IS AVAILABLE; requests for a solicitation will go unanswered. No award will be made from this Notice. Responses will be used to determine potential acquisition strategies, understand current market capabilities, and to gain knowledge of potential sources. GENERAL SCOPE: The Sacramento River Grand Island Mitigation Project is a restoration initiative on a 233-acre site located at the western tip of Grand Island in Sacramento County, California, situated at the confluence of the Sacramento River, Steamboat Slough, and Cache Slough. The project is designed to create and enhance approximately 84 acres of self-sustaining aquatic and riparian habitat as compensatory mitigation for the American River Common Features (ARCF) project. The construction scope entails approximately 108,000 cubic yards of total excavation to establish a tidal channel network and create an interior "habitat bowl" with islands and peninsulas, alongside breaching an existing berm to connect the site to Steamboat Slough. Excavated material will be utilized to construct on-site features such as the islands and peninsulas, while the remaining excess material will initially be placed in designated uncompacted fill areas on the island and, if settlement issues arise, hauled off-site by barge. To support the federally listed Western, Yellow-Billed Cuckoo, the revegetation plan establishes a continuous riparian corridor by planting water-tolerant trees and shrubs at lower elevations, transitioning to diverse, later-successional trees and native grasses at higher elevations. Project features also include protecting the Valley Elderberry Longhorn Beetle by transplanting impacted elderberry shrubs to designated on-site areas, followed by irrigation and maintenance of these transplants for the duration of this contract. To stabilize the breach, the design utilizes a hybrid bioengineered approach featuring a quarry stone riprap toe from the channel inverted up to 4 feet, transitioning to a bioengineered slope reinforced with erosion control fabrics and live willow cuttings above. Construction scheduling is subject to strict environmental windows, requiring all in-water work (such as activities in Steamboat Slough) to occur strictly between July 1st and October 31st. To isolate the breach work area from the active waterway during in-water construction, a temporary 250-foot-long steel sheet pile cofferdam must be installed and then fully removed upon project completion. The potential requirement may result in a firm-fixed-price solicitation issued approximately late November 2026. If solicited, the Government intends to award the anticipated requirement by mid-March 2027. The Government estimates that construction of the potential requirement can be completed within six hundred and sixty-five (665) calendar days from receipt of Notice to Proceed. If market conditions indicate this estimate may be unrealistic, respondents are encouraged to provide specific information (such as known equipment lead times or other timeline concerns) for Government consideration when responding to this Sources Sought Notice. The Government currently estimates the magnitude of construction for the potential project is between $15,000,000 and $20,000,000. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for the potential requirement is anticipated to be 562910, Remediation Services. The small business size standard for the NAICS, as established by the U.S. Small Business Administration, is $25,500,000 annual revenue. The Product Service Code for the potential requirement is anticipated to be Y1KZ, Construction of Other Conservation and Development Facilities. If there is a reasonable expectation that at least two (2) responsible small business concerns under this NAICS can provide the anticipated services at fair market prices, the Contracting Officer is required to set the acquisition aside for small business concerns. If competition is set-aside for small businesses, Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 52.219-14, Limitations on Subcontracting, requires that the Prime Contractor will not pay more than 85 percent of the amount paid by the Government for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to subcontractors that are not similarly situated entities. If no set aside is made, the requirement is competed with full and open competition, and the awarded Contractor is not a small business, the Contractor will be required to self-perform the percent of work identified in the solicitation under FAR 52.236-1, Performance of Work by the Contractor. Contractors with the skill, capabilities, workload capacity, and ability to obtain bonding to complete the project described above (either through self-performance and/or Subcontractor management) are invited to provide capability statements to the primary point of contact listed below. Other than small businesses are also encouraged to submit Capability Statements. CAPABILITY STATEMENT: Responses must be limited to ten (10) 8.5 x 11 inch pages with a minimum font size of point 10. Please provide the following information: 1) Company name, System for Award Management Unique Entity Identification number (SAM UEID) or Employer Identification Number (EIN), address, point of contact name, contact phone number, contact e-mail address, and statement identifying whether the company employs union or non-union workers. 2) Experience and capability to complete contracts of similar magnitude and complexity to the potential requirement, including at least three (3) examples of comparable work performed within the past six (6) years. Each example should include a brief description of the project, description of the work performed (identification of self-performance and/or Subcontractor management), customer name, customer satisfaction, timeliness of performance, dollar value of the project, and whether there were any challenges experienced during the project (delays, investigations, health and safety issues, labor shortages, management/organizational issues, etc.). 3) Business size and socioeconomic type for the applicable NAICS (ex: Woman-Owned Small Business, Serviced-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB), certified Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone), 8(a) Participant, small business, or other than small business (large business)). 4) Bonding capability (in the form of a Surety letter). Please submit all capabilities statements, information, brochures, and/or marketing material as one (1) document, limited to the page maximum above. Responses will not be considered an offer, proposal, or bid for any solicitation that may result from this Notice. Moreover, responses will not restrict the Government to an acquisition approach. This Notice is for information and planning purposes only. Respondents will not be notified of the results of any review conducted or the capability statements received. Please provide responses and/or questions by e-mail to the Contract Specialist, Jessica Padilla, at Jessica.Padilla@usace.army.mil by 1100 / 11:00 a.m. (PT) Tuesday, 27 October 2026. Please include the Sources Sought Notice number, �W9123827X1CQX�, in the e-mail subject line.

title: B-21 Field Training Detachment Facility, Dyess AFB-OT Feasibility & Business Feedback
description: SUBJECT: Sources Sought Notice/RFI �B-21 Field Training Detachment Facility, Dyess AFB DISCLAIMER: This Sources Sought (SS) is for planning and market research purposes only and does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP) or an Invitation for Bids (IFB). This notice is issued under the authority of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a (Other Transaction Authority for Construction and Repair) and is not subject to the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). No solicitation is available at this time. The Government will not pay for any information submitted in response to this notice. PURPOSE: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Fort Worth District, is conducting active public market intelligence to gauge industry interest, capacity, and capability from commercial construction firms, design-builders, and Non-Traditional Defense Contractors (NDCs). The intent is to gather critical feedback regarding advanced commercial construction methodologies, project delivery risks, and acquisition preferences to support our upcoming project delivery selection. PROJECT DESCRIPTION This project will construct a two-story, approximately 55,617 gross square foot Field Training Detachment facility for B-21 maintenance training at Dyess Air Force Base, Texas, with an estimated Construction Cost Limitation (CCL) of $66,200,000. The facility will feature a steel-frame structure with a metal roof, concrete masonry unit exterior walls, and a drilled concrete pier foundation system designed for local expansive soil conditions. Functional requirements include high bay trainers and classrooms for B-21 maintenance, substantial secure space constructed in compliance with Intelligence Community Directive (ICD) 705 standards with construction security surveillance, a 440-ton HVAC capacity, ducted communications, utilities, and associated site infrastructure and paving. INSTRUCTIONS TO INDUSTRY Review Attached Project Information Packet (PIP): Interested firms are directed to review the attached document. This packet provides comprehensive project requirements, constraints, and the complete questionnaire reference. title: Shipboard Air Conditioning Plant System Sustainment Plan (SSP)
description: 1.0 PURPOSE AND BACKGROUND PAE Maritime is conducting market research to identify responsible sources capable of providing some or all the sustainment capabilities required to support U.S. Navy surface-ship centrifugal, reciprocating, and rotary air conditioning (AC) plants worldwide. The information received will help the Government assess available industry capabilities and determine an appropriate acquisition strategy, contract structure, and number of sources. The Navy�s AC Plant System Sustainment Plan (SSP) establishes a standardized, scalable approach intended to improve materiel condition and operational availability across multiple AC plant configurations, ship classes, and geographically dispersed maintenance activities. The contemplated scope includes maintenance, technical expertise, materiel, rotable inventory management, engineering, logistics, training, and emergent field services. The Government is considering a range of acquisition approaches, which may include a single-award Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract, multiple contracts, or coordinated capabilities from multiple sources. No final acquisition strategy has been selected. Respondents may describe capabilities they can provide individually, through existing or proposed teaming arrangements, or as part of a broader sustainment solution. 2.0 CONTEMPLATED SUSTAINMENT CAPABILITIES The Government is seeking information on the capabilities summarized below and detailed in the Capability Certification Matrix (Table 1). Respondents may address any one or more capability areas. For each area addressed, identify current capabilities, how the work would be performed, and any relevant limitations, dependencies, or capability-development needs. 2.1 Major AC Plant Pit Stops Major Pit Stops include comprehensive plant assessment, troubleshooting, corrective maintenance, component repair or replacement, in-place compressor overhaul, testing, and restoration of the plant to operational condition. Major Pit Stops must be completed within a mandatory maintenance window of six weeks or less. Respondents should identify relevant experience, available personnel and facilities, configuration coverage, and demonstrated ability to meet this schedule. 2.2 Embedded AC&R Technical Expertise at SIMAs The Government is considering embedded air conditioning and refrigeration (AC&R) expertise at designated Navy Shore Intermediate Maintenance Activities (SIMAs) to support Sailor training and Navy-led Minor Pit Stops. Support may include hands-on instruction, troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and technical oversight. Minor Pit Stops must also be completed within a mandatory maintenance window of six weeks or less. 2.3 AC Plant Materiel Support This capability includes identifying, sourcing, procuring, managing, and delivering configuration-specific repair parts, components, assemblies, and overhaul materiel for planned maintenance, emergent repairs, casualty response, and restoration of AC plant capability. 2.4 Global Warehouse and Rotable Pool Management This capability includes establishing and managing rotable inventories and Overhaul Parts Packages (OPPs), including storage, configuration control, issue and return, repair or overhaul, replenishment, transportation, and positioning inventory to support geographically dispersed maintenance activities. 2.5 Engineering, Technical Data, Logistics, and Integrated Product Support This capability may include configuration-specific engineering and technical assistance, technical data and documentation, maintenance procedures, failure and root-cause analysis, technical dispositions, reliability and maintainability support, obsolescence management, and other Integrated Product Support. 2.6 Global Unplanned and Emergent Field Services This capability includes responsive technical troubleshooting, on-site assessment, engineering assistance, repair recommendations, identification and sourcing of required materiel, and other field services needed to restore AC plant capability at Navy locations worldwide. Respondents should describe geographic coverage, response capability, and the ability to support emergent work while meeting scheduled maintenance commitments. 3.0 CAPABILITY CERTIFICATION MATRIX AND SUPPORTING EVIDENCE Respondents should complete Table 1 for each capability area addressed. For each area, select YES, PARTIAL, or NO and identify the proposed method of performance: organic capability, existing OEM or license arrangement, subcontractor or teaming partner, or capability to be developed. A response of YES should reflect current capability. PARTIAL should identify the elements currently available and any gaps. NO indicates that the respondent does not currently possess the capability. Respondents may identify capabilities available through subcontractors, teaming partners, suppliers, license agreements, or other third-party arrangements. Clearly identify the organization responsible for each capability and whether the relationship is established or would need to be formed. Distinguish current capabilities from those that would require additional agreements, licensing, qualification, investment, or development. Provide concise, specific, and verifiable supporting information for each YES or PARTIAL response, as applicable. Useful evidence may include: Relevant contracts or programs, customers, periods of performance, and scope of work; AC plant configurations or comparable equipment supported and geographic locations served; Personnel, facilities, tooling, diagnostic or test equipment, inventory, and logistics infrastructure; Demonstrated maintenance capacity, schedule performance, response times, and relevant past performance; and Access to technical data, licenses, specialized resources, or other arrangements necessary to perform the work, including any material limitations. Respondents are not expected to provide a detailed technical proposal or develop a new solution in response to this notice. Concise evidence sufficient to describe the respondent�s capabilities and approach is encouraged. 4.0 ALTERNATIVE APPROACHES AND CAPABILITY GAPS Respondents may identify alternative approaches that could meet the Government�s underlying sustainment needs or improve maintenance execution, materiel availability, technical support, reliability, maintainability, or operational availability. Briefly describe the approach, the requirements it addresses, any differences from the contemplated approach, and any Government resources, approvals, or changes that would be necessary. The Government makes no commitment to adopting a proposed alternative. Respondents should identify any capability gaps, dependencies, or limitations that could affect performance, including the anticipated time and conditions needed to establish a capability. The Government may use this information to assess individual capabilities, combinations of capabilities, teaming approaches, and the feasibility of different acquisition structures. 5.0 RESPONSE FORMAT Responses should not exceed ten pages, excluding Table 1 and relevant supporting documentation. Respondents need only address the capability areas relevant to their organization and proposed approach. Please include: Company name and address, UEI, CAGE code, and business size/status; Primary point of contact, including email and telephone number; Completed Capability Certification Matrix (Table 1); A concise description of the capability areas addressed and the proposed method of performance; Specific supporting evidence for each YES or PARTIAL response, including relevant past performance where available; and Identification of any relevant teaming, subcontracting, licensing, technical-data access, or other third-party arrangements and their status. Responses may be submitted by a single organization or describe capabilities provided by a joint venture, contractor team, subcontractors, suppliers, licensors, or other par

title: V-22 Block B to Block C Mission Computer Obsolescence Initiative Procurement of Environmental Control System Components
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), Program Manager Air (PMA)-275, intends to award a sole-source Delivery Order to Honeywell International Inc. under Basic Ordering Agreement N0001923G0004 for the procurement of Environmental Control System (ECS) components in support of V-22 Block B to Block C Mission Computer Obsolescence Initiative (MCOI) upgrades. These components consist of: ECS Controller, National Stock Number (NSN) 4120-01-583-4350; Environmental Control Unit, NSN 1680-01-583-4344; Cockpit Flow Control Valve, NSN 1680-01-584-2936; Nosebay Avionics Cooling Supply Fan Motor, NSN 1680-01-482-7098; and Nosebay Fan Bracket, NSN 5340-01-545-5814. The required ECS components are necessary to support the integration, sustainment, and fielding of the Block B to Block C MCOI upgrade effort for the V-22 fleet. The estimated period of performance is two years, with anticipated award in September 2027. This action is being awarded on a sole-source basis to Honeywell International Inc. in accordance with the statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition under Title 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.103-1, �Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements.� Honeywell International Inc. is the original equipment manufacturer and current source with the requisite proprietary technical data, configuration knowledge, manufacturing capability, and supply-chain access necessary to provide components compatible with the existing V-22 ECS configuration. Award to another source would require the Government to obtain or develop technical data, conduct engineering analysis and qualification activities, establish manufacturing capability, and complete integration and airworthiness-related assessments. These actions would introduce unacceptable schedule, cost, configuration-control, and fleet-readiness risk to the V-22 Block B-to-C MCOI upgrade effort. Honeywell International, Inc. is the only source that has the knowledge, experience, technical expertise, and source data to provide these parts to meet the Government�s need. This notice is not a request for competitive proposals. However, responsible sources that believe they can satisfy the requirement may submit capability information demonstrating their ability to provide ECS components fully compatible with the V-22 configuration and required delivery schedule. Submitted information must address access to applicable technical data; manufacturing, quality-assurance, and configuration-management capability; and the ability to meet required delivery and support requirements.

title: Robotic Sheet Metal Forming CAPABILITY REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
description: This is a Capability Request for Information (CRFI) issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) and does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with responding to this notice. The United States Air Force Rapid Sustainment Office (RSO) is conducting market research analysis to identify existing solutions for an on-demand, dieless robotic sheet metal forming capability. This capability is intended to produce structural components, brackets, panels, skin sections, and spare parts for support equipment, and aircraft at depot, maintenance, or factory-level facilities. Traditional manufacturing of sheet metal parts relies on heavy, expensive tooling, dies, and presses that require long lead times, high upfront costs, and physical storage. Robotic sheet metal forming�utilizing dual-sided or single-sided synchronized robotic arm manipulators equipped with generic, interchangeable forming styli�offers a flexible, software-defined alternative. The objective of this research is to identify commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) or rapidly adaptable solutions capable of being integrated into standard industrial manufacturing and maintenance facilities. This capability is aimed at reducing reliance on traditional supply chains, eliminating the need for part-specific hard tooling, and dramatically accelerating low-volume manufacturing and prototyping cycles. Submitters are encouraged to highlight existing commercial technologies and details on how their hardware and software solutions can be integrated into industrial DoW facilities. Submitters may also identify optional services, such as operator training, technical support, tooling/stylus consumables, and system maintenance. See the attachment with this notice for additional details.

title: Z2DA--Construct Inpatient Tower 7th Floor, Cincinnati, OH
description: SYNOPSIS: INTRODUCTION: This Sources Sought Notice is for market research and information purposes only at this time and shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) is conducting a market survey and is seeking potential sources for Project 539-336: Construct Inpatient Tower 7th Floor at the Cincinnati VA Medical Center located in Cincinnati, Ohio. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: This project will construct a 6000sf addition on top of the 6th floor. This space will be used for inpatient mental health programs and clinics. It also includes the renovation of 9500sf of existing mental health space on the 7th floor for a total construction project of 15,500sf. This project will significantly increase patient privacy, enhance security and increase efficiency to the Veteran. The work includes hazardous materials abatement, uninterrupted critical service lines (power, gas, etc.), infection control, use of cranes and fall protection, phased construction plans, and significant work in the following divisions: structural, architectural, fire protection, plumbing, mechanical, electrical, and telecom. PROCUREMENT INFORMATION: The proposed project will be a competitive, firm-fixed-price contract utilizing the design-bid-build approach (Final Specifications and Drawings will be provided). The anticipated solicitation will be issued either as a Request For Proposal (RFP) in accordance with FAR Part 15, considering Technical and Price Factors or as an Invitation for Bid (IFB) in accordance with FAR Part 14, considering Price only. The results and analysis of the market research will finalize the determination of the procurement method. The type of socio-economic set-aside, if any, will depend upon the responses to this notice and any other information gathered during the market research process. This project is planned for advertising in December 2026. In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $10,000,000.00 and $20,000,000.00. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 236220 (size standard $45.0 million) applies to this procurement. The duration of the project is currently estimated at 730 calendar days from the issuance of a Notice to Proceed. The services for this project will include providing all construction related services such as: providing labor, materials and equipment required to complete the project as per contract documents prepared by an independent Architect-Engineer firm. CAPABILITY STATEMENT: Respondents shall provide a general capabilities statement to include the following information: Section 1: Provide company name, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), company address, Point-of-Contact name, phone number and email. Section 2: Provide company business size based on NAICS code 236220. Also, provide business type (i.e., Large Business, Small Business, Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Business, Women-Owned Small Business, Hub Zone Small Business, etc.). Section 3: Provide a Statement of Interest in the project. Section 4: Provide the prime contractor s available bonding capacity in the form of a letter of intent from your bonding company with this submission. *Please ensure that the individual bonding capacity is in line with the VAAR Magnitude of Construction listed above. Section 5: Provide the type of work your company has performed in the past in support of the same or similar requirement. This section is IMPORTANT as it will help to determine the type of socio-economic set-aside, if any. Please provide the following in your response: No more than three (3) contracts that your company has performed within the last seven (7) years that are of comparable size, complexity, and scope to this requirement. Include the project name, project owner and contact information as this person may be contacted for further information, project scope, project size (Example: square footage), building use (Example: Medical Facility, Office Building, etc.), project dollar value, start and completion dates. Provide specific examples that relate aspects of previous projects to the proposed project. Describe specific technical skills and key personnel your company possess to perform the requirements described under description of work. Describe your Self-Performed** effort (as either a Prime or Subcontractor). Describe Self-Performed work in terms of dollar value and description. **Self-Performed means work performed by the offeror themselves, NOT work performed by another company for them for any of the project examples provided. It is requested that interested contractors submit a response (electronic submission) of no more than eight (8) single sided pages, single-spaced, 12-point font minimum that addresses the above information. This response must be submitted as a single application-generated (not scanned) PDF document that is less than or equal to 4MB in size. Please note that hard copies will not be accepted. Please also include a cover page, which includes, at a minimum: the company s name, address, Unique Entity Identifier (if available), socio-economic status, point-of-contact name, phone number, and e-mail address. Responses must include the Sources Sought number and project title in the subject line of their e-mail response. Submissions (responses) shall be submitted via email to the primary and secondary points of contact listed below by October 27, 2026, at 5:00 PM ET. No phone calls will be accepted. The Capabilities Statement submitted in response to this Sources Sought shall not be considered to be a bid or proposal. This notice is for information and planning purposes only and is neither to be construed as a commitment by the Government nor will the Government pay for information solicited. No evaluation letters and/or results will be issued to the respondents. After completing its analyses, the Government will determine whether to limit competition among the small business categories listed above or proceed with full and open competition as other than small business. At this time no solicitation exists; therefore, please do not request a copy of the solicitation. If a solicitation is released it will be synopsized in Contract Opportunities at https://sam.gov/. It is the potential offeror's responsibility to monitor this site for the release of any solicitation or synopsis. Contracting Office Address: VHA Program Contracting Activity Central (VHA-PCAC) 6100 Oak Tree Blvd. Suite 490 Independence, OH 44131 Primary Point of Contact: Lucretia Maloney Contract Specialist lucretia.maloney@va.gov Secondary Point of Contact: Bill Henkel Contracting Officer William.henkel@va.gov

title: E21 PRCA HVAC REPLACEMENT
description: Planet Ranch Conservation Area HVAC Replacement The Bureau of Reclamation (Reclamation), Lower Colorado Basin, Multi-Species Conservation Program (MSCP), has a requirement to replace two existing HVAC systems on two bunk houses at Planet Ranch Conservation Area (PRCA). PRCA is located in a remote area outside of Parker, Arizona along the Bill Williams River. Access to the site is via an unpaved, sometimes primitive road that may be affected by weather and local conditions. Contractors should plan accordingly for transportation of personnel, materials, and equipment. Building 1 is approximately 3,000 square feet and Building 2 is approximately 2,400 square feet. Both buildings are single story houses. To support onsite work, contractors will have the option to stay in the existing bunk houses for the duration of the HVAC replacement activities. Government-furnished heavy equipment, including a telehandler, will be available onsite for use in removing the two existing HVAC units from the roof. This equipment may be used by the contractor in accordance with Reclamation's standards for government-furnished property. This requirement is 100% set-aside for small businesses. The project is expected to include two primary and distinct components; the stabilization and �make safe� preparation of Building 1 and the renovation and fit-out of an outpatient pharmacy within Building 3. Building 1 exterior work includes repair, restoration, and replacement of deteriorated building envelope components, restoration of the main entry walk and stair along with demolition of the existing temporary tunnel. Building 3 interior demolition and build out for a permanent pharmacy; with associated fire protection, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, communications, infection-control measures, commissioning, and turnover requirements. 3. description: Acordul-cadru va asigura organizarea unor programe de formare în domeniul comunicării (training-uri în comunicare), destinate următoarelor categorii de participanți: • personalului de conducere din cadrul MIPE, respectiv demnitari, înalți funcționari publici, directori generali, directori și șefi de serviciu, având în vedere rolul acestora în reprezentarea instituției și în asigurarea imaginii acesteia (purtători de imagine), precum și faptul că funcția de comunicare reprezintă o componentă a procesului de management; • personalului din cadrul DGCCI (Direcția Generală Comunicare și Cooperare Internațională), având în vedere atribuțiile acestuia în domeniul comunicării instituționale și al informării publice - inclusiv în ceea ce privește comunicarea cu mass-media și diseminarea informațiilor către publicul țintă al programelor finanțate din FEN 2021–2027 gestionate de MIPE; • membrilor Rețelei Naționale a Comunicatorilor, cu condiția ca aceștia să nu fi participat anterior la programe de formare cu tematică similară, finanțate din alte fonduri publice europene sau naționale. Training-urile vor avea loc în regiunile de dezvoltare ale României, în perioada 2026-2029, vor fi în număr de 5, cu maxim 30 de participanți/training. Activitatea de organizare a sesiunilor de training include asigurarea componentei logistice pentru asigurarea experților formatori pentru sesiunile de training, a secretariatului tehnic, asigurarea cazării 6 nopți pentru maxim 30 de persoane (respectiv 25 de cursanți/ sesiune și 5 persoane responsabile de organizare din partea Autorității Contractante, mic dejun inclus), asigurarea serviciilor de catering pentru maxim 30 de persoane/ sesiune, închirierea sălii de conferințe pentru 5 zile/ sesiune, asigurarea personalului tehnic necesar pe durata desfășurării sesiunii de training, tipărirea și distribuirea suportului de curs, amenajarea locației evenimentului cu materiale de signalistică, realizarea materialelor de signalistică, asigurarea serviciilor de transport. Valoarea estimată: bugetul maxim estimat al acordului-cadru este de 1.180.291,67 RON fără TVA. Bugetul minim estimat al acordului-cadru este de 236.058,33 RON fără TVA. Valoarea estimată minimă a unui contract subsecvent: 236.058,33 RON fără TVA. Valoarea maximă estimată a celui mai mare contract subsecvent: 708.175 RON fără TVA. Autoritatea contractantă estimează încheierea a minim 1 contract subsecvent, maxim 5 contracte subsecvente. Tipul procedurii de achizitie: Procedura proprie Posibilitatea depunerii de oferte alternative: Nu pot fi depuse oferte alternative. Legislația aplicată • OMIPE nr. 555/24.03.2025 privind aprobarea normelor interne privind atribuirea contractelor de achiziție publică/acordurilor-cadru organizate prin procedura de atribuire aplicabilă în cazul serviciilor sociale şi al altor servicii specifice. • LEGEA NR. 98/2016 privind achizitiile publice, cu modificarile si completarile ulterioare; • HOTĂRÂREA GUVERNULUI nr. 395/2016 pentru aprobarea Normelor metodologice de aplicare a prevederilor referitoare la atribuirea contractului de achiziţie publică/acordului-cadru din Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achiziţiile publice, cu modificarile si completarile ulterioare; Oferta câștigătoare va fi cea care va obține punctajul total cel mai mare. Criteriul de atribuire aplicat de Autoritatea Contractantă pentru această procedură este „Cel mai bun raport calitate-preț” în conformitate cu art.187, alin.(3), lit. a) din Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achizițiile publice, cu modificările și completările ulterioare. Autoritatea contractantă va încheia acordul cadru cu operatorul economic, a cărui ofertă admisibilă a fost clasată pe primul loc în urma aplicării criteriului de atribuire - cel mai bun raport calitate/preț. În situația în care egalitatea se menține, autoritatea contractantă va solicita operatorilor economici respectivi, pentru departajare, transmiterea unei noi propuneri financiare, în vederea stabilirii clasamentului final. Se solicită operatorilor economici să-și păstreze valabilitatea ofertei 6 luni de la data limită de depunere a ofertelor. Garanția de bună execuție: Garanția de bună execuție: se solicită constituirea garanției de bună execuție în valoare de 5 % din valoarea contractului fără TVA. Perioada de valabilitate a garanţiei de bună execuție va fi egală cu durata contractului subsecvent. Data limită pentru depunerea ofertei: 17.11.2026 (minim 30 zile de la data transmiterii spre publicare), ora 23:59 la adresa de e-mail: cristinel.cerbu@mfe.gov.ro. Data limită pentru transmiterea solicitărilor de clarificări: cu 20 zile inainte de termenul de depunere, ora 23:59. Data la care autoritatea contractantă va răspunde consolidat la solicitările de clarificări: cu minim 10 zile inainte de termenul de depunere, ora 23:59. title: Denmark – Management-related services – Kontrakt om drift af Banedanmarks svellefabrik
description: Banedanmark ønsker at indgå en kontrakt med en driftsleverandør, som kan forestå den daglige, løbende drift af Banedanmarks svellefabrik beliggende Vejlbyvej 1, 7000 Fredericia og således ved brug af svellefabrikkens produktionsapparat producere og levere betonsveller i form af strækningssveller og sporskiftesveller, herunder svelletyper til særlige sporkonstruktioner såsom skinneudtræk ved broer, i forspændt beton til brug for Banedanmarks varetagelse af opgaven som jernbaneinfrastrukturforvalter. Produktionen sker efter long line-metoden. Driftsleverandøren skal i forbindelse hermed blandt andet: - Forestå en rationel og økonomisk forsvarlig produktion og levering af betonsveller af typerne Strækningssveller og Sporskiftesveller i overensstemmelse med kontraktens vilkår, - Som minimum opfylde kravene i DS/EN ISO 9001:2015 eller en tilsvarende standard for kvalitetsledelsessystem, jf. bilag 5 - Forestå kvalitetssikring af svelleproduktionen, - Løbende samarbejde med Banedanmark om en tilrettelæggelse af driften af Svellefabrikken, herunder deltage i samarbejdsmøder, - For egen regning indkøbe de nødvendige råvarer og materialer, der indgår i produktionen, i det omfang disse ikke i henhold til kontrakten er bygherreleverancer, som Banedanmark leverer, - Stille den nødvendige tekniske og administrative ekspertise til rådighed for driften af Svellefabrikken, herunder rådgive Banedanmark om udvikling og tilpasning af produktionen, - Bistå Banedanmark i forbindelse med ændringer af Svellefabrikken, herunder omstilling af produktionsapparatet med henblik på produktion af andre svelletyper, - Medvirke til en hensigtsmæssig tilrettelæggelse og gennemførelse af afhentningen af sveller fra fabrikken, herunder forestå læsning af sveller i forbindelse med transport af færdigproducerede sveller fra Svellefabrikken. For information om den historiske produktion af sveller henvises til bilag 17 til kontrakten. Driftsleverandøren forventes at overtage ansvaret for driften af svellefabrikken den 1.1.2028. Perioden fra den 1.9.2027 og forventeligt frem til den 31.1.2028 betragtes som en etableringsperiode. I denne periode samarbejder parterne tæt om hurtigst muligt at få etableret grundlaget for en stabil og effektiv drift af Svellefabrikken i overensstemmelse med kontraktens vilkår. Der henvises i øvrigt til Bilag 6, tidsplan for etablering. Den daglige ledelse af Svellefabrikken skal forestås af en fabrikschef. Fabrikschefen skal være ansat hos Driftsleverandøren (Banedanmarks kontraktpart). Kommunikationen mellem den af Driftsleverandøren antagne fabrikschef og Banedanmark skal foregå på dansk. Kontrakten er ikke til hinder for, at Banedanmark kan indkøbe sveller af tredjemand. Banedanmark er berettiget til at videresælge sveller til tredjemand. Lovbekendtgørelse nr. 710 af 20.8.2002 om lønmodtageres retsstilling ved virksomhedsoverdragelse med senere ændringer (Virksomhedsoverdragelsesloven) finder anvendelse i forbindelse med Driftsleverandørens overtagelse af ansvaret for driften af Svellefabrikken. De nærmere oplysninger herom fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Ansøgere, som bliver prækvalificeret, vil have mulighed for at deltage i 2 fremvisninger af svellefabrikken. De konkrete datoer fremgår af tidsplanen i punkt 3 i udbudsbetingelserne.

description: Rahmenvereinbarung Kanalreinigung- und Inspektion für Einrichtungen der Bundesrepublik Deutschland in Schleswig-Holstein. _________________________________________________________________________________________________ Im Zuge von Bestandsaufnahmen zur Erstellung von LAKs (Liegenschaftsbezogenen Abwasserentsorgungskonzepten), Gewährleistungsabnahmen von Kanalsanierungsmaßnahmen, Kanalinspektionen vor Kanalsanierungsmaßnahmen, sowie Abnahmeinspektionen von Kanalsanierungsmaßnahmen sollen Schmutz- und / oder Regenwasserkanalisationen von Liegenschaften des Bundes vollständig und/oder teilweise gereinigt und auf Schäden untersucht werden. Die entsprechenden Liegenschaften können der beigefügten Liste entnommen werden. Es handelt sich um Liegenschaften mit weniger als 100 m Kanallänge bis zu mehreren Kilometern Kanalnetz. _________________________________________________________________________________________________ Hinweis: Beschränkung der Zahl der Lose, für die ein Bieter den Zuschlag erhalten kann. Die Abgabe eines Angebotes für mehrere Lose ist zulässig. Es wird allerdings pro Auftragnehmer maximal 1 Los beauftragt, da der Umfang der Arbeiten sehr umfangreich ist. Jeder Bieter kann Wünsche in Form einer Liste äußern, welches Los er vordringlich gewinnen möchte, sollte er der Bestbietende in mehreren Losen sein. Er erhält dann das Los, das in seiner persönlichen Liste auf Rang 1 ist. Fehlt diese Liste steht es der Vergabestelle frei das zu gewinnende Los festzusetzen. D. h. Im ersten Schritt wird geprüft, welcher Bieter welches Los gewinnt. Sollte jeder Bieter jeweils nur ein Los gewinnen, kommt das Verfahren nicht zur Anwendung. Wenn ein Bieter 2 Lose gewinnt erhält er den Zuschlag auf das Los, dass in seiner Wunschliste den höheren Platz hat. Der Gewinn des anderen Loses entfällt dann und es gewinnt das Los derjenige, der in dem Los auf Rang 2 ist. Sollte bei diesem Verfahren ein unwirtschaftliches Angebot den Zuschlag erhalten sollen, dann behält sich die Vergabestelle vor, die unwirtschaftlichen Lose aufzuheben und in einem Verhandlungsverfahren ohne Teilnahmewettbewerb neu auszuschreiben. _________________________________________________________________________________________________ Die Ausschreibung wird in folgende regionale Lose aufgeteilt: Los 1: Flensburg Glücksburg Los 2: Nordfriesland Schleswig-Flensburg Los 3: Rendsburg-Eckernförde Los 4: Pinneberg Steinburg Dithmarschen Los 5: Kiel Neumünster Lübeck _________________________________________________________________________________________________ Für diese Rahmenvereinbarung gelten die folgenden Höchstwerte für die zu erbringenden Leistungen im ausgeschriebenen Zeitraum: Los 1: 710.000,00 € netto. Los 2: 1.480.000,00 € netto. Los 3: 930.000,00 € netto. Los 4: 820.000,00 € netto. Los 5: 1.540.000,00 € netto. title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Machbarkeitsstudie Generalsanierung
description: Erstellung einer interdisziplinären Machbarkeitsstudie für die Generalsanierung der Bayerischen Staatsoper Nationaltheater Das Nationaltheater ist der Spielort der Bayerischen Staatsoper, des Bayerischen Staatsorchesters und des Bayerischen Staatsballetts. In seiner jetzigen neoklassizistischen Erscheinung wurde das Opernhaus im Jahr 1818 erstmals eröffnet. Fünf Jahre später wurde das Haus durch einen Brand zur Gänze zerstört und erneut aufgebaut. Der zweite Wiederaufbau nach der Zerstörung im Zweiten Weltkrieg bis auf die Außenmauern fand in den Jahren 1958 – 1963 statt. Seit der Wiedereröffnung im Jahr 1963 wurde keine Generalsanierung durchgeführt. Zum Gebäudekomplex gehört auch das Dekorationsmagazin entlang der Alfons-Goppel-Straße und das im Jahr 2003 fertiggestellte sog. „Neue Probengebäude“ am Marstallplatz. Weitere für den Probe- und Spielbetrieb genutzte Gebäude sind die Gebäude des Bayerischen Staatsballetts, Platzl 6 und 7, hierbei handelt es sich um ehemalige Corpsgebäude, die 1899 im Stil der Renaissance errichtet wurden. Mit zeitlichem Vorlauf und parallel zur Machbarkeitsstudie wird von Nutzerseite die Erstellung eines Bedarfsgesamtkonzepts einschließlich Visionsentwicklung („Oper der Zukunft“) beauftragt. Gleichzeitig wird außerdem die Bedarfsplanung für eine Interimslösung während der Generalsanierung des Nationaltheaters erstellt. Die Machbarkeitsuntersuchung soll in einem iterativen Prozess mit dem Nutzer und der Bedarfsplanung fortwährend abgeglichen werden. Die Beiträge und Ergebnisse aus der Machbarkeitsstudie sollen sodann in die Bedarfsplanung integriert werden und umgekehrt. Die Studie sollte sich mit den baulich- technischen Sanierungsnotwendigkeiten, funktionalen Optimierungen der betrieblichen Abläufe, möglichen Erweiterungsoptionen, den wesentlichen Belangen des Denkmalschutzes und, nicht zuletzt, den Möglichkeiten energetischer Optimierung der haustechnischen Anlagen auseinandersetzen. Bei der Erstellung der Machbarkeitsstudie sind insbesondere die Ziele des nachhaltigen Bauens zu verfolgen. Ein ganzheitlicher Ansatz ist vorzusehen um den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Gebäude unter Berücksichtigung der ökologischen, ökonomischen und soziokulturellen Qualität sowie der technischen und prozessualen Aspekte zu betrachten. Der Auftragsgegenstand beinhaltet die Erstellung einer Machbarkeitsstudie für die oben genannten Nutzungen in drei Varianten als Entscheidungsgrundlage für die in der Zukunft geplante Generalsanierung. Weitere Angaben sind der Aufgabenbeschreibung und den Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Construction project management services – Forensik - Köln-Merheim, Generalplanerleistung
description: Am Standort Köln Merheim plant der Landschaftsverband Rheinland (LVR) die bauliche Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden forensisch psychiatrischen Klinik. Hintergrund ist, dass das derzeit genutzte Gebäude den aktuellen baulichen und funktionalen Anforderungen nicht mehr entspricht und dauerhaft überbelegt ist. Vorgesehen ist die Realisierung einer forensisch psychiatrischen Klinik durch einen Neubau in konventioneller Bauweise unter Einbeziehung des bestehenden Gebäudes, das erhalten und gegebenenfalls weitergenutzt werden soll. Das Vorhaben umfasst sowohl eine quantitative Erweiterung der Platzzahl und die Anpassung der Raumgrößen als auch eine qualitative und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung der forensischen Versorgung. Gegenstand des Auftrags sind Projektsteuerungsleistungen für das Vorhaben Forensik Köln-Merheim, und zwar - Projektsteuerungsleistungen entsprechend dem Leistungsbild gemäß § 2 des Abschnitts 2 von Heft Nr.9 "Projektmanagementleistungen in der Bau- und Immobilienwirtschaft - Standards für Leistungen und Vergütung" der AHO-Schriftenreihe, 6. Auflage Mai 2025) und - Ergänzende (Besondere) Projektsteuerungsleistungen Mit Vertragsschluss wird der Auftragnehmer zunächst mit den Leistungen der Projektstufen 1 und 2 betraut. Die stufenweise Beauftragung erfolgt, um in der Leistungsphase 2 zunächst eine Bauvoranfrage durchzuführen und deren Ergebnis abzuwarten, bevor über die Fortführung des Vorhabens in den nachfolgenden Projektstufen entschieden wird. Die Leistungen der Projektstufen 3 bis 5 können von der Auftraggeberin nachträglich insgesamt oder einzeln beauftragt werden.

title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Generalplanungsleistungen für die Sanierung und Instandsetzung der Tiefgarage Hospitalstraße 6, 55232 Alzey
description: Die Stadt Alzey beabsichtigt die Vergabe von Generalplanungsleistungen für die Instandsetzung einer schadensbedingt sanierungsbedürftigen Tiefgarage in der Hospitalstraße 6, 55232 Alzey. Gegenstand der Maßnahme ist die Planung, Koordinierung, Ausschreibung, Vergabeunterstützung und objektüberwachende Begleitung der erforderlichen baulichen und technischen Sanierung sowie Instandsetzungsmaßnahmen. Grundlage der Planung sind die Ergebnisse des vorliegenden Untersuchungsberichts sowie die dort festgestellten Schadensbilder und Handlungsempfehlungen. Die Tiefgarage weist nach vorliegenden Untersuchungen erhebliche Schäden an den tragenden Stahlbetonbauteilen, an Bodenflächen, Rampen, Treppenhausanschlüssen sowie an technischen Einbauten auf. Als wesentliche Schadensursachen wurden chlorid- und carbonatisierungsinduzierte Bewehrungskorrosion, Undichtigkeiten, Rissbildungen, Hohllagen und Schäden an Oberflächen und Beschichtungen festgestellt; der Instandsetzungsbedarf ist kurzfristig gegeben. Ziel der zu vergebenen Leistung ist die Erarbeitung eines fachlich belastbaren, wirtschaftlichen und dauerhaft tragfähigen Instandsetzungskonzepts sowie die vollständige Planung und Begleitung der Umsetzung bis zur mängelfreien Fertigstellung. Die Instandsetzung ist so zu planen, dass die Tiefgarage nach Abschluss der Maßnahme wieder den Anforderungen an Standsicherheit, Dauerhaftigkeit, Verkehrssicherheit und Gebrauchstauglichkeit entspricht und eine weitere planmäßige Nutzungsdauer von 40 Jahren ermöglicht. Die Tiefgarage befindet sich im Nordwesten der Stadt Alzey und wird über die Hospitalstraße 6 erschlossen. Sie wurde im Jahr 1980 errichtet. Die Anlage besteht aus einem Bauteil, das nachträglich teilweise mit einem dreigeschossigen Wohn- und Geschäftshaus sowie einer Steinhalle überbaut wurde. Die verbleibenden Flächen oberhalb der Tiefgarage werden als zusätzliche Parkflächen genutzt. Insgesamt stehen rund 176 PKW-Stellplätze zur Verfügung, die sich auf zwei Parkgeschosse verteilen und öffentlich zugänglich sind.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Mobilitätsdrehscheibe Bahnhof Plochingen - Nichtoffener Realisierungswettbewerb mit Ideenteilen und TNWB und anschließendem Verhandlungsverfahren nach VgV - Objektplanung Freianlagen/ Verkehrsanlagen
description: Übergeordnetes Ziel des Wettbewerbsverfahrens ist die Entwicklung eines attraktiven und zukunftsfähigen Bahnhofsumfelds als Visitenkarte der Stadt Plochingen. Als bedeutender Mobilitätsknoten kommt dem Bahnhofsumfeld eine zentrale Bedeutung für das Ankommen in der Stadt sowie für die Verknüpfung unterschiedlicher Mobilitätsformen zu. Durch ein qualitätsvolles freiraum- und verkehrsplanerisches Konzept soll das Bahnhofsareal seiner Funktion als multimodale Verkehrsdrehscheibe künftig in einem attraktiv gestalteten Umfeld gerecht werden. Mit der Neugestaltung des Bahnhofsumfelds sollen attraktive, barrierefreie und klimaangepasste öffentliche Räume mit sicheren und übersichtlichen Wegeverbindungen für alle Verkehrsteilnehmenden geschaffen werden. Dabei sind die unterschiedlichen Anforderungen der verschiedenen Mobilitätsformen auf engem Raum zu berücksichtigen. Ziel ist die Entwicklung einer leistungsfähigen und multimodalen Verkehrsdrehscheibe, die eine sichere, effiziente und intuitive Verknüpfung aller Verkehrsarten gewährleistet und zugleich neue Mobilitätsangebote integriert. Insgesamt sollen das Stadtbild verbessert und die Aufenthaltsqualität im öffentlichen Raum nachhaltig gestärkt werden, sodass das Bahnhofsumfeld künftig mehr ist als ein reiner Transitraum. Der Realisierungswettbewerb zielt auf eine Vielzahl von freiräumlichen und funktional ganzheitlich betrachteten Lösungsansätzen sowie auf die Vergabe eines Planungsauftrags für die Objektplanung Freianlagen und Verkehrsanlagen mind. Lph 1-5 im Umfeld des Bahnhofs ab. Außerdem sollen Konzepte für die Anbindung und konzeptionelle räumliche Struktur der Ideenteile gesammelt werden.

title: Germany – Building construction work – Stadt Bochum: Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer Sonnenschule, Lange Malterse 18
description: Die Stadt Bochum (nachfolgend "Auftraggeber") steht als Schulträger vor der Herausforderung, dem stetig wachsenden Raumbedarf aufgrund der steigenden Schulanmeldungen im Bochumer Stadtgebiet zu entsprechen. In diesem Zusammenhang herrscht - neben dem Erfordernis an Sanierungs- und Erhaltungsmaßnahmen bereits bestehender Schulgebäude - ein erheblicher Bedarf an der Schaffung neuer Sport- und Lernräume. Dabei ist der Auftraggeber nach dem Schulgesetz verpflichtet, Schulentwicklungsplanung zu betreiben. Zur Erfüllung dieser ihr gesetzlich obliegenden Pflicht plant der Auftraggeber dem wachsenden Raumbedarf im Rahmen eines umfassenden Schulbau- und Schulmodernisierungsprogramm zu begegnen. Dieses beinhaltet erforderliche Neubau-, Umbau- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen für 27 schulische Einrichtungen. Das Programm umfasst dabei alle Schularten und bezieht sich auf Grund-, Förder- und weiterführende Schulen. Eingebettet in dieses Schulbauprogramm soll nun die Erweiterung und der Umbau der Sonnenschule, Lange Malterse 18, 44795 Bochum erfolgen. Die bauliche Erweiterung sowie der Umbau der Sonnenschule soll durch einen Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer erfolgen. Die Sonnenschule ist eine vierzügig geplante Grundschule im Bochumer Stadtteil Weitmar. Das Schulgelände umfasst ein bestehendes Schulgebäude (ca. 900 m² bebaute Fläche), eine Sporthalle (ca. 500 m²) sowie ausgedehnte Schulhof- und Grünflächen. Das Bestandsgebäude ist nicht barrierefrei erschlossen. Die vorhandene Schüleranzahl von 206 SuS (SJ 2023/24) wird bis zum Schuljahr 2030/31 auf prognostizierte 276 SuS anwachsen. Die bestehenden Unterrichts- und OGS-Flächen sind für diesen Bedarf nicht ausreichend. Der Erweiterungsbedarf ergibt sich sowohl im Unterrichtsbereich (+4 Unterrichtsräume) als auch im OGS-Bereich (+142 m²). Die geplante Maßnahme soll in drei Schritten realisiert werden: Schritt 1: Temporäre Containeranlage (Nutzung ab SJ 2025/26) / bereits erfolgt Schritt 2: Neubau Cluster (Nutzung ab SJ 2030/31) Der Neubau ist gemäß der beiliegenden Machbarkeitsstudie angedacht als zwei- bis dreigeschossiger Baukörper in L-förmiger Kubatur entlang der Straße Lange Malterse und am Eingang des Schulhofs. Ziel ist eine kompakte Bebauung, die den Schulhof möglichst wenig zerstückelt und den vorhandenen Baumbestand weitgehend erhält. Schritt 3: Umbau / Umnutzung Bestand (nach Fertigstellung Neubau) Die Umbaumaßnahmen im Bestand beinhalten im Wesentlichen die Umnutzung einzelner Räume im Untergeschoss, Erdgeschoss und im 1.Obergeschoss. Gleichzeitig ist die Herstellung der südlichen, befestigten und unbefestigten Schulhoffläche nach der Fertigstellung des Neubaus vorgesehen. Dies umfasst ca. 2.245 m² Fläche. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung ist die Planung und Errichtung der baulichen Erweiterung inklusive vorbereitender Arbeiten gemäß der Beschreibung der Schnittstellen der Ausführung in der funktionalen Leistungsbeschreibung. Die vollständige funktionale Leistungsbeschreibung wird mit Aufforderung zur Angebotsabgabe zur Verfügung gestellt. Aus dieser werden die planerischen Schnittstellen zwischen den verschiedenen Disziplinen, Gewerken und Fachbereichen zu entnehmen sein. Mit dieser EU-weiten Bekanntmachung wird der Teilnahmewettbewerb eingeleitet. Weitere Informationen sind den auf der Vergabeplattform zur Verfügung gestellten Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.
